options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

**Items:** ensure all logically relevant items can be acquired. Some items, such as keys, may be self-locking, and
some locations may be inaccessible.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

Items: ensure all logically relevant items can be acquired. Some items, such as keys, may be self-locking, and some locations may be inaccessible.

options.name: Character Stages
options.doc: Whether to include Reinhardt-only stages, Carrie-only stages, or both with or without branching paths at the end of Villa and Castle Center.

options.name: Stage Shuffle
options.doc:
Shuffles which stages appear in which stage slots.
Villa and Castle Center will never appear in any character stage slots if Character Stages is set to Both; they can only be somewhere on the main path.
Castle Keep will always be at the end of the line.

options.name: Starting Stage
options.doc: Which stage to start at if Stage Shuffle is turned on.

options.name: Warp Order
options.doc: Arranges the warps in the warp menu in whichever stage order chosen, thereby changing the order they are unlocked in.

options.name: Sub-weapon Shuffle
options.doc: Shuffles all sub-weapons in the game within each other in their own pool or in the main item pool.

options.name: Spare Keys
options.doc:
Puts an additional copy of every non-Special key item in the pool for every key item that there is.
Chance gives each key item a 50% chance of having a duplicate instead of guaranteeing one for all of them.

options.name: Special1s Per Warp
options.doc:
Sets how many Special1 jewels are needed per warp menu option unlock.
This will decrease until the number x 7 is less than or equal to the Total Specail1s if it isn't already.

options.name: Total Special1s
options.doc: Sets how many Speical1 jewels are in the pool in total.

options.name: Dracula's Condition
options.doc:
Sets the requirement for unlocking and opening the door to Dracula's chamber.
None: No requirement. Door is unlocked from the start.
Crystal: Activate the big crystal in Castle Center's basement. Neither boss afterwards has to be defeated.
Bosses: Kill a specified number of bosses with health bars and claim their Trophies.
Specials: Find a specified number of Special2 jewels shuffled in the main item pool.

options.name: Percent Special2s Required
options.doc: Percentage of Special2s required to enter Dracula's chamber when Dracula's Condition is Special2s.

options.name: Total Special2s
options.doc: How many Speical2 jewels are in the pool in total when Dracula's Condition is Special2s.

options.name: Bosses Required
options.doc:
How many bosses need to be defeated to enter Dracula's chamber when Dracula's Condition is set to Bosses.
This will automatically adjust if there are fewer available bosses than the chosen number.

options.name: Carrie Logic
options.doc:
Adds the 2 checks inside Underground Waterway's crawlspace to the pool.
If you (and everyone else if racing the same seed) are planning to only ever play Reinhardt, don't enable this.
Can be combined with Hard Logic to include Carrie-only tricks.

options.name: Hard Logic
options.doc:
Properly considers sequence break tricks in logic (i.e. maze skip). Can be combined with Carrie Logic to include Carrie-only tricks.
See the Game Page for a full list of tricks and glitches that may be logically required.

options.name: Multi-hit Breakables
options.doc:
Adds the items that drop from the objects that break in three hits to the pool.
There are 18 of these throughout the game, adding up to 79 or 80 checks (depending on sub-weapons being shuffled anywhere or not) in total with all stages.
The game will be modified to remember exactly which of their items you've picked up instead of simply whether they were broken or not.

options.name: Empty Breakables
options.doc: Adds 9 check locations in the form of breakables that normally have nothing (all empty Forest coffins, etc.) and some additional Red Jewels and/or moneybags into the item pool to compensate.

options.name: Lizard Locker Items
options.doc:
Adds the 6 items inside Castle Center 2F's Lizard-man generators to the pool.
Picking up all of these can be a very tedious luck-based process, so they are off by default.

options.name: Shopsanity
options.doc:
Adds 7 one-time purchases from Renon's shop into the location pool.
After buying an item from a slot, it will revert to whatever it is in the vanilla game.

options.name: Hard Item Pool
options.doc: Replaces some items in the item pool with less valuable ones, to make the item pool sort of resemble Hard Mode in the PAL version.

options.name: Shop Prices
options.doc:
Randomizes the amount of gold each item costs in Renon's shop.
Use the Minimum and Maximum Gold Price options to control how much or how little an item can cost.

options.name: Minimum Gold Price
options.doc: The lowest amount of gold an item can cost in Renon's shop, divided by 100.

options.name: Maximum Gold Price
options.doc: The highest amount of gold an item can cost in Renon's shop, divided by 100.

options.name: Post-Behemoth Boss
options.doc: Sets which boss is fought in the vampire triplets' room in Castle Center by which characters after defeating Behemoth.

options.name: Room of Clocks Boss
options.doc: Sets which boss is fought at Room of Clocks by which characters.

options.name: Renon Fight Condition
options.doc: Sets the condition on which the Renon fight will trigger.

options.name: Vincent Fight Condition
options.doc: Sets the condition on which the vampire Vincent fight will trigger.

options.name: Bad Ending Condition
options.doc: Sets the condition on which the currently-controlled character's Bad Ending will trigger.

options.name: Increase Item Limit
options.doc: Increases the holding limit of usable items from 10 to 99 of each item.

options.name: Nerf Healing Items
options.doc: Decreases the amount of health healed by Roast Chickens to 25%, Roast Beefs to 50%, and Healing Kits to 80%.

options.name: Loading Zone Heals
options.doc:
Whether end-of-level loading zones restore health and cure status aliments or not.
Recommended off for those looking for more of a survival horror experience!

options.name: Invisible Items
options.doc:
Sets which items are visible in their locations and which are invisible until picked up.
'Chance' gives each item a 50/50 chance of being visible or invisible.

options.name: Drop Previous Sub-weapon
options.doc: When receiving a sub-weapon, the one you had before will drop behind you, so it can be taken back if desired.

options.name: Permanent PowerUps
options.doc:
Replaces PowerUps with PermaUps, which upgrade your B weapon level permanently and will stay even after dying and/or continuing.
To compensate, only two will be in the pool overall, and they will not drop from any enemy or projectile.

options.name: Ice Trap Percentage
options.doc:
Replaces a percentage of junk items with Ice Traps.
These will be visibly disguised as other items, and receiving one will freeze you as if you were hit by Camilla's ice cloud attack.

options.name: Ice Trap Appearance
options.doc: What items Ice Traps can possibly be disguised as.

options.name: Disable Time Requirements
options.doc:
Disables the restriction on every event and door that requires the current time to be within a specific range, so they can be triggered at any time.
This includes all sun/moon doors and, in the Villa, the meeting with Rosa and the fountain pillar.
The Villa coffin is not affected by this.

options.name: Skip Gondolas
options.doc:
Makes jumping on and activating a gondola in Tunnel instantly teleport you to the other station, thereby skipping the entire three-minute ride.
The item normally at the gondola transfer point is moved to instead be near the red gondola at its station.

options.name: Skip Waterway Blocks
options.doc:
Opens the door to the third switch in Underground Waterway from the start so that the jumping across floating brick platforms won't have to be done.
Shopping at the Contract on the other side of them may still be logically required if Shopsanity is on.

options.name: Countdown
options.doc: Displays, near the HUD clock and below the health bar, the number of unobtained progression-marked items or the total check locations remaining in the stage you are currently in.

options.name: Big Toss
options.doc:
Makes every non-immobilizing damage source launch you as if you got hit by Behemoth's charge.
Press A while tossed to cancel the launch momentum and avoid being thrown off ledges.
Hold Z to have all incoming damage be treated as it normally would.
Any tricks that might be possible with it are not in logic.

options.name: Panther Dash
options.doc:
Hold C-right at any time to sprint way faster.
Any tricks that are possible with it are not in logic and any boss fights with boss health meters, if started, are expected to be finished before leaving their arenas if Dracula's Condition is bosses.
Jumpless will prevent jumping while moving at the increased speed to make logic harder to break with it.

options.name: Increase Shimmy Speed
options.doc:
Increases the speed at which characters shimmy left and right while hanging on ledges.
Hold Z to use the regular speed in case it's needed to do something.

options.name: Fall Guard
options.doc: Removes fall damage from landing too hard. Note that falling for too long will still result in instant death.

options.name: Death Link
options.doc:
When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.

Explosive: Makes received death links kill you via the Magical Nitro explosion instead of the normal death animation.

options.name: Window Color R
options.doc: The red value for the background color of the text windows during gameplay.

options.name: Window Color G
options.doc: The green value for the background color of the text windows during gameplay.

options.name: Window Color B
options.doc: The blue value for the background color of the text windows during gameplay.

options.name: Window Color A
options.doc: The alpha value for the background color of the text windows during gameplay.

options.name: Background Music
options.doc:
Randomizes or disables the music heard throughout the game.
Randomized music is split into two pools: songs that loop and songs that don't.
The "lead-in" versions of some songs will be paired accordingly.

options.name: Map Lighting
options.doc:
Randomizes the lighting color RGB values on every map during every time of day to be literally anything.
The colors and/or shading of the following things are affected: fog, maps, player, enemies, and some objects.

options.name: Cinematic Experience
options.doc: Enables an unused film reel effect on every cutscene in the game. Purely cosmetic.

options.name: Local Items
options.doc: Forces these items to be in their native world.
options.doc_html: Forces these items to be in their native world.

options.name: Non-local Items
options.doc: Forces these items to be outside their native world.
options.doc_html: Forces these items to be outside their native world.

options.name: Start Inventory
options.doc: Start with the specified amount of these items. Example: {Bomb: 1, Arrow: 3}
options.doc_html: Start with the specified amount of these items. Example: {Bomb: 1, Arrow: 3}

options.name: Start Inventory from Pool
options.doc:
Start with the specified amount of these items and don't place them in the world. Example: {Bomb: 1, Arrow: 3}

The game decides what the replacement items will be.
options.doc_html:
Start with the specified amount of these items and don't place them in the world. Example: {Bomb: 1, Arrow: 3}

The game decides what the replacement items will be.

options.name: Start Hints
options.doc: Start with these item's locations prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.
options.doc_html: Start with these item's locations prefilled into the !hint command.

options.name: Start Location Hints
options.doc: Start with these locations and their item prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.
options.doc_html: Start with these locations and their item prefilled into the !hint command.

options.name: Excluded Locations
options.doc: Prevent these locations from having an important item.
options.doc_html: Prevent these locations from having an important item.

options.name: Priority Locations
options.doc: Prevent these locations from having an unimportant item.
options.doc_html: Prevent these locations from having an unimportant item.

options.name: Item Links
options.doc: Share part of your item pool with other players.
options.doc_html: Share part of your item pool with other players.

options.doc: Generic items plando.
